Instructions for Use
Device description: The Sable Pacemaker System is a cardiac pacing system. It is available in lengths from 8 mm to 48 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Safety Information
MR Conditional (1.5-Tesla): spatial field gradient ≤ 3 T/m (300 Gauss/cm); Whole-Body SAR ≤ 0.4 W/kg; Maximum Head SAR 1 W/kg; Normal Operating Mode.
Device configuration during MRI: MRI SureScan mode.
Scanning at 7 T has not been evaluated; do not scan at field strengths other than those listed.
Patients may be scanned immediately after implantation.
